rules: Render as one continuous 10-second 2D hand-drawn bare-knuckle martial arts fight on the tournament platform. OUTFIT & SIDE LOCK: Fighter A stays on screen-left facing right (+Z) and Fighter B stays on screen-right facing left (-Z) for all 10.0 seconds (zero side swaps, zero weapons). Maintain realistic strike reach at all times with both arms separate from the torso in silhouette on every hit. At 0.00s (one full leg's length (1.10m)), A steps off-line on his left foot and whips a baseball-bat right shin horizontally into the outside of the lead calf while B has his left calf chopped sideways out from under him, his knee buckling inward as he catches his balance (hold 3f). At 0.88s (one full leg's length (1.10m)), A drives off his right foot in a sharp forward step to close the gap into striking range while B slips his head briskly to the inside while loading weight onto the right hip. At 1.76s (one full arm's length (0.80m)), A steps deep into the pocket and whips a razor-sharp horizontal right elbow point across the brow and cheekbone while B has his jaw whipped violently sideways in the direction of the hook as sweat sprays from his brow (hold 3f). At 2.64s (one full arm's length (0.80m)), A locks both forearms tightly in front of his face in a rigid high shell guard to absorb the blow while B drives a heavy straight punch with the right fist down the centerline toward the jaw (hold 3f). At 3.52s (one full arm's length (0.80m)), A slips his head sharply to the outside of the incoming punch while coiling his left shoulder then immediately digs a tight shovel hook with the left fist underneath the elbow into the floating ribs while B folds forward at the waist with a sharp exhale as the blow sinks into his ribs (hold 3f). At 4.40s (one full arm's length (0.80m)), A steps into the pocket and hooks his left palm behind the back of the neck in a tight collar tie while B has his neck pulled forward into the clinch while his hands brace against the shoulders for posture (hold 3f). At 5.28s (chest-to-chest clinch reach (0.58m)), A pulls down hard on the collar tie and spears his bent right kneecap vertically upward into the solar plexus while standing on his left pillar leg while B jackknifes forward at the waist inside the clinch as the knee buries deep into his solar plexus (hold 3f). At 6.16s (chest-to-chest clinch reach (0.58m)), A plants both open palms flat against the chest and shoves violently forward to break the clinch and create striking space while B is shoved backward out of the clinch to full arm's length, his heels skidding across the floor as he catches his balance (hold 3f). At 7.04s (one full arm's length (0.80m)), A crunches his left elbow down tight against his hip and ribs to block the body shot while B slips his head briskly to the inside while loading weight onto the right hip then immediately sinks his hips and drives a straight right fist deep into the midsection (hold 3f). At 8.85s (one full arm's length (0.80m)), A slips his head briskly to the inside while loading weight onto the right hip then immediately spins in place on his left foot and drives his right heel straight back into the solar plexus while B folds forward at the waist with a sharp exhale as the blow sinks into his ribs (hold 6f). Pure 2D cel-shaded anime, no 3D CGI, no on-screen text or numbers.
